name: IEX_DUNNING_PLANS_B_
description: This table stores the header level information for dunning plans.

columns.name: DUNNING_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The earliest date that this dunning plan can be used.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The last date the dunning plan can be used.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the dunning plan is enabled for use.

columns.name: AGING_BUCKET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of aging bucket from aging bucket table.

columns.name: SCORE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the IEX_SCORES table.

columns.name: DUNNING_LEVEL
columns.description:
Level at which we are sending
                                               dunning(Party/Account/BillTo/Delinquency)

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description:
Concurrent Program who column -
                                               application id of the program
                                               that last updated this row
                                               (foreign key to
                                               FND_APPLICATION.APPLICATION_ID).

columns.name: PROGRAM_ID
columns.description:
Concurrent Program who column -
                                               program id of the program that
                                               last updated this row (foreign
                                               key to
                                               FND_CONCURRENT_PROGRAM.CONCURRENT_PROGRAM_ID).

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description:
Concurrent Program who column -
                                               date when a program last updated
                                               this row).

columns.name: SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional UIs.

columns.name: INCLUDE_CURRENT
columns.description: Flag to determine if current invoices should be included in the dunning letter.

columns.name: INCLUDE_DISPUTED
columns.description: Flag to determine if disputed amounts should be included in the dunning letter.

columns.name: INCLUDE_TRX_COPY
columns.description: Flag to determine if invoice copies should be included with the dunning letter.

columns.name: INCLUDE_CREDIT_MEMO
columns.description: Flag to determine if credit memos should be included in the dunning letter.

columns.name: AGED_STAGED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the dunning plan is staged or aged.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
